name: Haven on Geddes
description: Student community at 1700 Geddes Ave beside Nichols Arboretum. The live floor-plans page (checked 2026-11-20) shows two 3-bedroom layouts, a Ranch and a Bi-Level with flex bedroom, priced per bed with private bedrooms. Provider materials describe about 62 homes for groups of roughly 3-6 and list '1.1 mi to Central Campus' (provider claim, not used for scoring; routing uses the OSRM matrix).
